name: Intelliwriter SEO
author: usmanqamarofficial

sections.description:
AI-powered SEO plugin with automation agents.

External services

This plugin relies on the following third-party/external services to provide its AI-powered SEO features. These requests are essential to the plugin’s core functionality.

Intelliwriter (api.intelliwriter.io / superagents.intelliwriter.io / backlink.intelliwriter.io)
This is the plugin’s own vendor backend. It is used to proxy Google Search Console indexing/analytics requests, run the backlink-discovery agent, and handle license/subscription verification. Data sent includes your site’s URL, the specific page/URL being inspected or indexed, and your license/access token. This happens whenever you use the Indexation, Analytics, or Backlinks agents, or when checking your subscription status.
Terms of Service | Privacy Policy

OpenAI (api.openai.com)
Used to generate AI content: meta titles/descriptions, content rewrites, and image alt text. The post content, title, and/or keywords you are optimizing are sent to OpenAI’s Chat Completions API whenever you use the Content Optimizer, Metadata Agent, Image SEO Agent, or Snippet/Auto-Fix tools.
Terms of Use | Privacy Policy

Google Search Console (accounts.google.com / oauth2.googleapis.com / www.googleapis.com / searchconsole.googleapis.com)
Used to authenticate with your Google account (OAuth) and read/submit Search Console data (site list, search analytics, URL inspection/indexing requests) for the site you connect. This occurs when you connect Google Search Console and whenever indexation or analytics data is requested.
Terms of Service | Privacy Policy
